# Generator miner guide

Choose **original 20-hex task IDs** from [the pinned pool](https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/releases/tag/sn120-math-prior-v1).

1. Activate your registered hotkey.
2. Test the current king.
3. Submit before the UTC deadline.

```sh
affine-generator --help
```

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `s / n` | Passes / rollouts |
| `q` | Middle-band posterior probability |

> Accepted tasks earn equal per-task weight for 24 hours.

Raw HTML such as <script>alert("not executable")</script> is displayed as text.
